pamir-highway-murghab-sary-tash.title: Pamir Highway: Murghab to Sary Tash
pamir-highway-murghab-sary-tash.slogan: Murghab to Sary Tash, over 4655 m · one way, about 475 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Murghab
waypoints.advice: Murghab is where the day begins. Next is Ak Baital Pass.

waypoints.name: Ak Baital Pass
waypoints.advice: Ak Baital Pass comes up 158 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Karakul, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Karakul
waypoints.advice: 317 km in you reach Karakul. Next is Sary Tash.

waypoints.name: Sary Tash
waypoints.advice: Sary Tash closes the day.

sections.advice: Murghab → Ak Baital Pass climbs about 4655 m in 70 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Ak Baital Pass → Karakul drops about 4655 m over 63 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Karakul → Sary Tash is 103 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

pamir-highway-murghab-sary-tash.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Pamir Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Murghab → Ak Baital Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.7%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Ak Baital Pass → Karakul
scenicChapters.narrative: 4655 m come off over 127 km at around 7.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

pamir-highway-murghab-sary-tash.story: A one-way ride of 475 km, Murghob to the finish - roughly 6 h 31 in the saddle. The stops in between: Ak Baital Pass and Karakul. The highest point is about 4,650 m. It crosses from Tajikistan into Kyrgyzstan - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
